ifstat_count.description: Number of updates before stopping. 0 or empty means unlimited.

ifstat_delay.description: Delay between updates in seconds. Supports decimals (min 0.1).

ifstat_driver.description: Driver to use for gathering stats (e.g., proc, snmp, ifmib).

ifstat_driver_opts.description: Options for the driver (e.g., alternate proc file or SNMP comm@host/nn).

ifstat_interfaces.description: List of interface names to monitor. Comma-separated in CLI.

ifstat_kbits.description: Report bandwidth in kbits/sec instead of kbytes/sec (-b).

ifstat_monitor_all.description: Enable monitoring of all interfaces found, including inactive ones (-a).

ifstat_no_header.description: Turn off displaying the header periodically (-n).

ifstat_no_scroll.description: Keep stats on the same line if possible (-S).

ifstat_snmp_target.description: SNMP target configuration [comm@][#]host[/nn]. Overrides driver_opts if driver is snmp.

ifstat_subsequent_delay.description: Second delay for subsequent polls, separated by '/'. If empty, uses first delay only.

ifstat_timestamp.description: Add timestamp at beginning of each line (-t).

ifstat_total_bandwidth.description: Report total bandwidth for all monitored interfaces (-T).

ifstat_wrap_lines.description: Wrap lines larger than terminal width (-W).
